checkpoints.name: Execution and disclosure authorization
checkpoints.what_changed: The assessment-bound gate is now mandatory for every real TokenHarbor dispatch. The previous flag (project1_objective_live_dispatch_enabled) was removed because it allowed provider-enabled + gate-disabled, which is a bypass.

mechanism.bound_to: isinstance(provider, CloudTokenHarbor) captured at module import time
mechanism.why_not_a_flag: A substituted adapter (offline test double) redefines the TokenHarbor symbol; a lazy isinstance would let the double switch the requirement off. The real class is captured at import so patching cannot reach it.

key_cases: no configuration switch can disable the gate
a real TokenHarbor adapter always carries the registered gate
a substituted adapter is not a cloud dispatch
provider enabled without a record holds before dispatch
a moved source refuses even with a matching record
a packet for another confirmation refuses
a matching record and source pass
a different prompt refuses at request time

checkpoints.still_missing: No operator-provisioned record exists in project1_ai.synthetic_trial_authority. The provider remains disabled. No dispatch attempted.

checkpoints.name: BCB V1.2.1 context verification
checkpoints.observed: Context fa3cb714 on assessment 053b3768 (revision 20) is PERSISTED but source_is_current=false, so both the objectives panel and the route's BCB gate refuse it.
checkpoints.narrowing: BCB-V1-1.2.1 IS a registered contract (business_context_v1.py:66 CONTRACTS), so the early 'builder_version not in CONTRACTS' return is not the cause. Revisions agree (assessment.revision = confirmed_revision = context.assessment_revision = 20). The remaining term is compatible = _reproduces(...) = False.
remaining_causes: _build() raises for this packet and the exception is swallowed
the rebuilt packet_hash differs from the stored packet_hash
checkpoints.secondary_defect: BCB-REPRO-02: persisted_business_context_service.py:274 catches every exception and returns False, so an operator cannot tell why a context is unusable. Diagnosability defect, not a security defect.
checkpoints.preservation: No context row, proposal row or provenance row was modified.
